Tom — thanks, and appreciate the clear ask. Sending an initial plan below; I've looped in Priyom (assurance/product ops) for evidence cadence and Karthik (legal) for the MSA/order form redlines and inspection language.

Summary plan (high level):
1) Evidence mapping: Redwood will fill the attached spreadsheet with control mapping and a link to the canonical artifact location (S3/Confluence). Target delivery: 5 business days. Owner: Priyom.
2) Pen test window: We support two inspection modalities — a) bounded privileged inspection (privnet request + timeboxed access to non-production artifacts) or b) monitored remote pen test (staging, remote observers). For production-facing tests we require an 8–14 day lead and a 7-day window. We can propose Q4 week of Nov 13 as a tentative slot. Owner: Neha + infra on-call.
3) Access & NDAs: For privileged inspection we ask for a scoped access request form and POA for any shared credentials; legal needs to agree on non-disclosure and evidence handling. Owner: Karthik.
4) SLA/Exceptions: If the MSA needs an SLA carveout for pen testing (downtime risk, rollback), we will propose a canary approach and a formal incident fallback.

Can you confirm which modality (privileged vs. remote) Lumina prefers? If privileged, please share a short list of testers and required IP ranges.

I'll upload a filled mapping excel and a suggested inspection runbook once Priyom and I align.

Thanks —

Neha/Priyom — quick legal read and redline notes for the MSA/order form security exhibit. I kept this high level; I can produce a tracked redline if helpful. Key points:

1) Audit rights: recommend limiting "on-site/privileged" inspections to a bounded window (max 5 business days of privileged access) unless otherwise escalated. For remote/observed tests we can agree to a 7-day window with rolling start dates.
2) Evidence requests: add a clause that evidence delivery timelines are "reasonable and commercially practicable" and call out a 10-business-day standard response for non-privileged artifacts.
3) Data handling: any shared logs or screenshots provided for evidence must be treated as confidential and returned/destroyed within 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

Redlines to propose to Lumina:
- Add a short appendix listing the types of artifacts we can and cannot provide (SIEM exports, scoped config docs, no raw PII tables).
- For penetration testing, require testers to sign a scoped engagement letter that includes permitted tools and prohibited destructive testing.
- If Lumina requests privileged access outside the defined windows, require prior written approval and an SLA credit negotiation for any customer impact.

I'll attach a draft MSA redline and an action item sheet for evidence ownership. Priyom, please confirm the artifact locations and who will own the Confluence pages so I can reference them in the redline.

—Karthik
